text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Track and Field Meet,
as I headed to the track to watch—

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan, do your best!
Aim for 1st place, fight on!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'll aim for 1st place and give it all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan!
Give it your all, and please come back safe...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You trained with none other than myself!
I will not forgive you if you turn in a shameful run!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fuh, so you too aspire to be the lead in this opera.
Then let us play a concerto together and illuminate everyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Concert...? 
I don't really get it, but I'll run my hardest!
And then the starting gun sounded, but—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Here I gooo~!
...Wait, wah-wah-wah!

text_block_list.name: Female Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Haru Urara has tripped right after the start
from putting in too much momentum!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ouchie... I scraped my knee...
—Wait, everyone's already way ahead!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... I'm not giving up! I'll do my best~!
Urarararararara~~~!!!

After that, Haru Urara quickly got up
and ran with all her might, but—

text_block_list.name: Female Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The one claiming victory in this close race is TM Opera O!
TM Opera O crosses the finish line first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*Hup*, *ho*...!
G-Gooooal~~~...!

Amidst loud cheers from her friends,
Haru Urara finished in last place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan...!
Are you okay...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, *haa*...! I'm totally okay!
Even though I messed up at the start!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
You did great though, Urara-chan!
Even after falling, you set a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Yaaay, I did it, I did it~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent...! To display such radiant bravery
in the face of tribulation...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, applause for her! A grand round of applause
for the one who shone brightest after myself, the lead!

Responding to TM Opera O's words,
every spectator clapped for Haru Urara's valiant effort.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~!
I don't really get it, but thank youuu~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a brilliant opera.
A radiance uniquely your own, impossible for even me to emulate.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I am the Sun, then you are surely the Sunflower.
Captivating all eyes through sheer simplicity. Such is your brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh...?
I don't really get it, but—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, sunflower seeds taste delicious, right!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You fool!
That's not what she's talking about at all!

Surrounding Haru Urara's heartwarming scene,
the area was wrapped in warm laughter.
